description: A pink sheeted surface is in front with a light cloth under the left hand and a small spray bottle in the right hand, with a pale pillow or backing sheet behind. The left hand presses the left-hand object cloth down and wipes across the sheet in short strokes, moving slightly right and back left, while the right hand holds the right-hand object spray bottle near the surface and shifts it inward as if preparing to spray but mostly keeps it hovering.
